name: Lobo
tagline: An inference firewall that steers an LLM's internal activations away from harmful concepts during generation.

awards: Best AI Safety & Alignment Evaluations - Sponsored by Virginia AI Security Initiative

problem: Prompt-based safety is fragile against jailbreaks.
solution: Precomputes activation-space directions for seven harmful concepts and intervenes inside the model during generation, with an admin dashboard.
demo_moment: Team-described: adjust concept sliders and see a jailbreak fail.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best AI Safety & Alignment Evaluations - Sponsored by Virginia AI Security Initiative” among 231 submissions.
Works inside the model rather than on prompts.

lessons: Intervene where the behaviour is computed.
